SELECT i.id AS id, i.INSTANCE_ID AS instanceId, i.ENDPOINT AS endpoint, i.INSTANCE_NAME AS instanceName, i.INSTANCE_DESC AS instanceDesc, i.INSTANCE_SUMMARY AS instanceSummary, i.IP AS ip, i.IS_ENABLE_MONITOR AS isEnableMonitor, i.IS_ENABLE_ALARM AS isEnableAlarm, i.MONITOR_ENV AS monitorEnv, i.MONITOR_GROUP AS monitorGroup, p.`NAME` AS name, p.ACTIVE_COUNT AS activeCount, p.COMPLETED_TASK_COUNT AS completedTaskCount, p.TASK_COUNT AS taskCount, p.LARGEST_POOL_SIZE AS largestPoolSize, p.POOL_SIZE AS poolSize, p.CORE_POOL_SIZE AS corePoolSize, p.MAXIMUM_POOL_SIZE AS maximumPoolSize, p.QUEUE_SIZE AS queueSize, p.REJECTED_TASK_COUNT AS rejectedTaskCount, p.REJECTED_EXECUTION_HANDLER_NAME AS rejectedExecutionHandlerName, p.QUEUE_REMAINING_CAPACITY AS queueRemainingCapacity, p.QUEUE_TYPE AS queueType, p.QUEUE_CAPACITY AS queueCapacity, p.ALLOW_CORE_THREAD_TIME_OUT AS allowCoreThreadTimeOut, p.KEEP_ALIVE_TIME AS keepAliveTime, p.UTILIZATION_RATE AS utilizationRate FROM MONITOR_JAVA_THREAD_POOL p LEFT JOIN MONITOR_INSTANCE i ON p.INSTANCE_ID = i.INSTANCE_ID
WHERE p.INSTANCE_ID = #{instanceId}
